text:
MSN 1885 (F) Amendment 1 ILO work in fishing convention, 2007: survey and inspection
Details of arrangements for the survey, inspection and documentation of compliance for fishermen's living and working conditions on UK fishing vessels.
Documents
Details
This notice should be read with the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) (Survey and Certification) Regulations 2018 and the ILO guidelines for flag State and port State inspections for the work in fishing convention and replaces MSN 1885 (F) ILO work in fishing convention survey and inspection.
Amendment 1 updates reference information only.
Notice to
- fishing vessel owners
- fishing vessel operators
- managers
- manning agents and fishermen
